name: Drivepoint
description:
Drivepoint is the AI data and finance platform for consumer brands. Connect your sales, marketing, operations and finance data in one place, then use it to build reports, models and analyses with built-in consumer brand expertise and best practices. All the power of Claude pointed at a unified context and data layer built specifically for brands like yours.
After a one-click OAuth sign-in, Claude can work directly with your Drivepoint data — exploring your warehouse, querying actuals, reviewing your financial plans, and producing reports and analyses grounded in your real numbers. No SQL or spreadsheet wrangling required.
The connector ships built-in analyst guidance — a data dictionary, sample queries, a report catalog, and artifact style guides — that Claude loads automatically so it uses the correct columns, metric definitions, and conventions for your data.
Every tool is read-only: the connector never writes, modifies, or deletes data. Access is limited to the companies your Drivepoint account is authorized for, and your data is fetched in real time and never stored by the connector.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Drivepoint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Drivepoint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.drivepoint.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Drivepoint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drivepoint provides these MCP tools: get_drivepoint_user, get_plan, get_schema, get_skill, list_company_plans, list_datasets, list_skills, list_tables, and run_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Drivepoint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Drivepoint in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Drivepoint requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Drivepoint is developed by Drivepoint. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
